sql: SELECT relname AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS heap, pg_size_pretty(pg_indexes_size(c.oid)) AS indexes, to_char(c.reltuples,'FM999999999') AS est_rows, round(100.0*pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)/pg_database_size(current_database()),1) AS pct FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind='r' ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) DESC LIMIT 30
